passage: Dear Members of the Harborview Community Association, As spring approaches, our neighborhood botanical garden is preparing to launch its annual Youth Pollinator Education Program, which introduces local elementary students to native bees, butterflies, and backyard conservation. Over the past three years, demand from neighborhood schools has doubled, yet our existing wooden greenhouse lacks the space and climate-control equipment needed to host hands-on workshops safely during unpredictable spring weather. To expand our capacity and welcome more than four hundred students this season, we are organizing a community fundraising drive to install insulated glass panels and raised planting tables. Any financial contribution—or donation of gardening tools and potting soil—will directly support environmental education for our children. Please visit our website by April 15 to pledge your support or sign up as a workshop volunteer. Warm regards, Elena Morales, Garden Coordinator
